records.title: Unnamed chromium site 515
records.subtitle: AK | Ore Site | chromium
records.search_text: unnamed chromium site 515 ak chromium chromium

row.source_dataset: USGS Critical mineral deposits of the United States v2.0
row.production_text: Production Red Mountain area (1943-1958): about 26,000 tonnes of ore containing from 38 to 43% Cr2O3 (Foley, 1992). From 1943 to 1958, the Chrome Queen mine produced 6,650 tonnes and the Star No. 4 mine produced 19,350 tonnes (Foley and Barker, 1985).
row.resources_text: Reserve (1985): 1,584,000 tons Cr2O3; data is for a group of 33 chromite deposits in the Red Mountain area. About 88,000 tonnes chromic oxide are contained in 20 relative high-grade deposits with more than 20% chromite. The bulk of the reserves, 1.35 million tonnes, is in three low-grade deposits that contain 5 to 6% Cr2O3. These are the Turner Stringer Zone (1.13 million tonnes Cr2O3), the Star Stringer Zone (189,000 tonnes Cr2O3), and the Horseshoe Stringer Zone (26,000 tonnes Cr2O3) (Foley, 1992).
